title: excellent reminder system
body:
Great app with an excellent reminder system. 
iCloud sync and Shortcuts integration needs elbow grease though
author: Jurpik83040

title: After updating my premium has disappeared
body:
I’ve been habit user for a half year and was really enjoying the app, but after updating the app recently my premium disappeared. 
I wish you could return my premium and not make me feel disappointed.
author: your_user
